name: @entro314labs/ai-changelog-generator
description: AI-powered changelog generator with MCP server support - works with most providers, online and local models

scripts.build: pnpm exec tsc --noCheck -p tsconfig.json && chmod +x dist/bin/*.js
scripts.lint: pnpm exec oxlint . --ignore-pattern node_modules --ignore-pattern dist --ignore-pattern build --ignore-pattern coverage --ignore-pattern test/vitest-results
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm exec oxlint . --fix --fix-suggestions --ignore-pattern node_modules --ignore-pattern dist --ignore-pattern build --ignore-pattern coverage --ignore-pattern test/vitest-results
scripts.lint:fix-unsafe: pnpm exec oxlint . --fix --fix-suggestions --fix-dangerously --deny-warnings --ignore-pattern node_modules --ignore-pattern dist --ignore-pattern build --ignore-pattern coverage --ignore-pattern test/vitest-results
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.test:providers: pnpm run build && vitest run test/providers.test.ts
scripts.test:cli: pnpm run build && vitest run test/cli.test.ts
scripts.test:core: pnpm run build && vitest run test/core.test.ts
scripts.test:services: pnpm run build && vitest run test/services.test.ts
scripts.test:utils: pnpm run build && vitest run test/utils.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build && vitest run test/integration.test.ts
scripts.test:mcp: pnpm run build && vitest run test/mcp.test.ts
scripts.test:styling: pnpm run build && vitest run test/cli-ui.test.ts test/colors.test.ts test/styling-integration.test.ts
scripts.test:styling-e2e: pnpm run build && vitest run test/cli-styling-e2e.test.ts --testTimeout=60000
scripts.mcpb:build: pnpm run mcpb:validate && pnpm run mcpb:pack
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run check && pnpm run build && pnpm run test
scripts.postinstall: node -e "console.log('🎉 AI Changelog Generator installed!⚡ Quick Start:  ai-changelog                 - Generate changelog  ai-changelog --detailed      - Detailed analysis  ai-changelog --interactive   - Interactive mode  ai-changelog-mcp            - Start MCP server🤖 AI Models Supported:  • Vercel AI Gateway (one key, every model)  • GPT-5.6, Claude 5, Gemini 3.x, DeepSeek V4  • Local models via Ollama / LM Studio  • Automatic model selection📖 Docs: https://github.com/entro314-labs/AI-changelog-generator© All trademarks belong to their respective owners.')"
